summary: Increment-style operation over an array of 32-bit words treated as a big bit string of arbitrary length. It adds a single-bit mask at bit position (31 - a2 % 32) into the word at index a2 / 32 via OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition, then, while the previous add reports overflow, propagates a carry by adding 1 to each preceding word in turn. Returns the last overflow indicator from the propagation chain.

operations.description: Compute the target word index a2 / 32 and the bit mask 1 << (31 - a2 % 32) for the addressed bit position.
OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition adds the bit mask to the word at a1 + 4 * (a2 / 32), storing the result back at that word; its return value reports overflow.
Guard on v3 = a2 / 32 - 1 >= 0; carry propagation only runs while there are lower words to carry into.
do-while loop over preceding words (a2 / 32 - 1 down to 0) that stops early once an add stops overflowing.
For each preceding word, OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition adds 1 to that word and stores it back; result keeps the overflow indicator.
Return the final overflow indicator result from the last addition performed.
Called by BitArrayClearBitAndZeroFillSubsequentWords (0x0059525D) as the bit-array word-update helper.

unresolved: Direction of the carry semantics depends on whether OverflowCheckedUnsignedAddition returns nonzero on overflow or on success; the loop break condition implies nonzero means continue propagating.
Whether the caller treats the array as a big bit string or as packed numeric words is not established by this function alone.
